  18      Validators and custom fields should raise this exception.
  19  
  20      :param message: An error message, list of error messages, or dict of
  21          error messages. If a dict, the keys are subitems and the values are error messages.
  22      :param field_name: Field name to store the error on.

  24      :param valid_data: Valid (de)serialized data.
  25      """

  27      def __init__(

  29          message: str | list | dict,
  30          field_name: str = SCHEMA,
  31          data: typing.Mapping[str, typing.Any]
  32          | typing.Iterable[typing.Mapping[str, typing.Any]]
  33          | None = None,
  34          valid_data: list[typing.Any] | dict[str, typing.Any] | None = None,
  35          **kwargs,
  36      ):
  37          self.messages = [message] if isinstance(message, (str, bytes)) else message
  38          self.field_name = field_name
  39          self.data = data
  40          self.valid_data = valid_data
  41          self.kwargs = kwargs

  44      def normalized_messages(self):
